ready: (curl -sf -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat ~/.cache/huggingface/token)" https://huggingface.co/datasets/miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets/resolve/main/approvals/gt-ss2.json >/dev/null) && nvidia-smi >/dev/null 2>&1 && test -d /workspace/neural-landscape && ! pgrep -f simple_trainer >/dev/null && ! pgrep -f offline-render >/dev/null
script:
set -e
export DENO_INSTALL=$HOME/.deno
command -v $DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || (curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh -s -- -y >/dev/null 2>&1)
cd /workspace/neural-landscape
export GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1; git pull -q --ff-only || true
$DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-net --allow-run --allow-env \
  --node-modules-dir=auto --unstable-webgpu tools/offline-render.ts \
  --flight=flight-03-look-right --fps=10 --width=1920 --height=1080 --gt
cd artifacts/gt && tar czf /tmp/gt-flight-03-look-right.tar.gz flight-03-look-right
python3 /workspace/pod-runtime/pod/hf_upload.py --repo miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets --prefix scenes/kazbek-run-c10-gt /tmp/gt-flight-03-look-right.tar.gz
echo GT-flight-03-look-right-DONE
